## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Venice, Italy. It starts at Peggy Guggenheim Collection, Dorsoduro, 701.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Twiddle your beards, both real and fake as you peruse one of the most important museums for 20th-century art. The Peggy Guggenheim Collection in Venice boasts works by Picasso, de Chirico, Dalí, Pollock, Kandinsky and Magritte, amongst others.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €23.65. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 205 ratings and 82 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
